name: Uwerx WERX fee burn charged to the sending Uniswap pair
summary: WERX's _transfer credits the recipient the full amount and, when the recipient is uniswapPoolAddress (left at its 0x…01 placeholder), burns a further 1% from the sender. The attacker flash-loaned WETH, bought most of the pair's WERX, sent it back and skimmed it to that address so the extra burn came out of the pair's reserve, synced, and sold WERX for all the pair's WETH.
notes: Non-upgradeable token; uniswapPoolAddress was never set and the only later write (marketing wallet) is not needed by the exploit.

Loss is the pair's WETH. The WERX taken from the pair was bought with flash-loaned WETH in the same transaction and is worthless after the drain; the follow-up 0x54698b1e re-ran the path on the empty pair and moved nothing.
